faqs.question: What's the difference between Premium and Black Label?
faqs.answer: Premium includes access to the Discord community, manually curated team flow, the daily newsletter, the macro calendar, educational material and the Quant Studio self-service tools. Black Label adds the algorithmic layer: real-time flow with automatic scoring and bot notifications, distributed identically to all subscribers of the tier.

faqs.question: Does Black Label include everything in Premium?
faqs.answer: Yes. Black Label is a higher tier that includes everything in Premium, plus access to the real-time algorithmic layer.

faqs.question: Is the content personalised?
faqs.answer: No. All content, including Black Label bot notifications, is distributed identically to all members of the corresponding tier. We do not respond to a single member's portfolio or profile.

faqs.question: Do you offer investment advice?
faqs.answer: No. We do not provide investment advice under FinSA, nor portfolio management under FinIA. Operational decisions are always the member's.

faqs.question: How do bot notifications work?
faqs.answer: They are algorithmic market commentary distributed to all subscribers of the tier. They are not personal recommendations and should not be treated as such.

faqs.question: Do I need trading experience to join?
faqs.answer: Basic market knowledge helps, but the community is designed to be accessible even for investors who are still learning.

faqs.question: Are signals provided?
faqs.answer: No. We offer structure, context and strategic insights — not blind trade calls.

faqs.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel at any moment; access remains valid until the end of your billing cycle.

faqs.question: How do free trials work?
faqs.answer: You get full access during the trial period. If you cancel before it ends, you will not be charged.

faqs.question: What markets do you focus on?
faqs.answer: Primarily U.S. equities, options and flow-based market signals.
